purpose: Teach: 参事官/占有/便宜/納付/受託/公然/始動/散会

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界団体の参事官と親交を深められたぞ
lines.en: Your father deepened his ties with the industry association's secretary.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Voice carries the weight of remembered pride. Steady pace, like recounting something that still matters. Slight lift of affection on 'father'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事務所の占有面積を最大化されました
lines.en: Yes. Father maximized the office space with real purpose.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Not celebratory—more the steady acknowledgment of a son understanding his father's choices. Measured, respectful. A slight pause before speaking, like choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お得意様への便宜を惜しまなかった
lines.en: Your father never hesitated to go the extra mile for his valued clients.
lines.style: Tender but not sentimental. Voice softens slightly on 'extra mile.' The tone of someone reflecting on generosity he witnessed. Gentle pace, like the memory itself is precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは納付期限を厳守された
lines.en: Yes. Father kept to his commitments with absolute integrity.
lines.style: Steady, grounded response. A son speaking of his father's character without embellishment. Clear-eyed respect. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新規の受託事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Your father took on new commissioned work and built it from the ground up.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet admiration. Slightly more energy than before—there's life in the memory of his father's ambition. Pace remains measured but warmer, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは公然と理念を語られた
lines.en: Yes. Father spoke openly about his ideals wherever people would listen.
lines.style: A moment of deeper recognition here. Slower, more deliberate. The son understanding that his father's principles mattered more than most things. Slight warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業初期、自ら工場を始動された
lines.en: Your father started that factory with his own hands, back in the early days.
lines.style: Voice carries deep respect and affection. Slower pace. The tone of someone marveling at his father's courage and determination. Almost tenderly amazed, as if seeing it clearly for the first time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、ご来客を見送ってから散会されました
lines.en: Yes. Father saw his guests to the door before he ever allowed himself to rest.
lines.style: Final, quiet statement. Voice is steady and full of understanding. This detail—the politeness, the care even in closing—is everything. Soft close, like a farewell itself.
